stage.name: Watery Tidehollow
stage.description:
As the tides surge, the Seaborn grow restless deep within a vast cavern. With the help of the remaining Iberian machines there, eliminate the Seaborn threat once and for all.
<Special Conditions> DP will not regenerate naturally

nourished_slider.name: Nourished Slider
nourished_slider.flavourText: A Sea Terror that crawled onto the shore and has sated its hunger. Its appendages can cause protein denaturation.

nourished_runner.name: Nourished Runner
nourished_runner.flavourText: A Sea Terror that grew four limbs and has sated its hunger. It controls its body's movements using hydraulic pressure and possesses superior reflexes.

shell_sea_runner.name: Shell Sea Runner
shell_sea_runner.flavourText: A Sea Terror that grew four limbs, but lacks an internal skeleton. It seems to have once hunted quadrupeds on land.

nourished_spitter.name: Nourished Spitter
nourished_spitter.flavourText: A mysterious Sea Terror that has sated its hunger. Its spit is a way to deal with natural disasters, rather than as a means of hunting.

nourished_drifter.name: Nourished Drifter
nourished_drifter.flavourText: A Sea Terror that floats in the air and has sated its hunger. Its body contains a blazing-hot organ.

deep_sea_slider.name: Deep Sea Slider
deep_sea_slider.flavourText: A Sea Terror that crawled onto the shore. It brandishes its tough appendages menacingly.

automatic_maintenance_drone.name: Automatic Maintenance Drone
automatic_maintenance_drone.flavourText: An old Iberian automatic maintenance drone. For some reason, it is still operational and will repair facilities.
abilities: Activates nearby Emergency Aid Buildings, greatly enhancing their ability to recover Nervous Impairment
Does not deplete Life Points when spared or upon dying, but can be damaged by allied units

floating_sea_drifter.name: Floating Sea Drifter
floating_sea_drifter.flavourText: A Sea Terror that floats in the air. It seems that the next generation will be even more proficient at swimming through the air.

ridge_sea_spitter.name: Ridge Sea Spitter
ridge_sea_spitter.flavourText: A mysterious Sea Terror. In the sea, it can spit at even greater speeds, fast enough to destroy reefs.

nourished_piercer.name: Nourished Piercer
nourished_piercer.flavourText: A Sea Terror that grew a solid organ and has had its hunger sated. It sways gently beneath the moonlight.
abilities: Prioritizes attacking the target with the current lowest HP percentage within a small area

nourished_reaper.name: Nourished Reaper
nourished_reaper.flavourText: A Sea Terror that emits ear-splitting screeches and has sated its hunger. It is essentially harmless if you don't disturb it.
abilities: Starts battle in Standby and will not attack
After being injured, this unit becomes Combat-Ready, gradually losing HP over time and continually inflicting Nervous Impairment to nearby units

nourished_crawler.name: Nourished Crawler
nourished_crawler.flavourText: A Sea Terror imbued with impurities that has had its hunger sated. Such Sea Terrors are rarely seen nowadays, as they are gradually evolving to become more nimble.
abilities: Whenever a certain percentage of HP is lost, immediately deal a large amount of Arts damage and Nervous Impairment to nearby units

basin_sea_reaper.name: Basin Sea Reaper
basin_sea_reaper.flavourText: A Sea Terror that emits ear-splitting screeches. Should its nourishment be interrupted, it will immediately counterattack any nearby threats, until all other signs of life have ceased.
abilities: Starts battle in Standby and will not attack
After being injured, this unit becomes Combat-Ready, gradually losing HP over time and continually inflicting Nervous Impairment to nearby units

primal_sea_piercer.name: Primal Sea Piercer
primal_sea_piercer.flavourText: A Sea Terror that grew a solid organ. The other parts of its body seem to be forming impregnable outer spikes.
abilities: Prioritizes attacking the target with the current lowest HP percentage within a small area

pocket_sea_crawler.name: Pocket Sea Crawler
pocket_sea_crawler.flavourText: A Sea Terror imbued with impurities. The density of its body tissue surpasses that of some alloys. Victims stabbed by it will feel as if they have been set alight.
abilities: Whenever a certain percentage of HP is lost, immediately deal a large amount of Arts damage and Nervous Impairment to nearby units

the_first_to_talk.name: The First To Talk
the_first_to_talk.flavourText: The first beautiful living being to speak human language before civilized man. Seaborn.
abilities: [Corrosive Vacuoles] Periodically unleashes Vacuoles on the target and a unit in the four adjacent tiles with the lowest Nervous Impairment accumulation, dealing Physical damage and Nervous Impairment

devices.description: Activates when there is a friendly unit or <Automatic Maintenance Drone> in the four adjacent tiles
